components.name: Button
components.summary: The button of the three apps: primary, secondary, danger and ghost, with icons, disabled and loading, in the phone and captain themes.

components.name: Icon
components.summary: Every line icon of the first set on the 24 grid, at three sizes, as the apps draw them.

components.name: TextLink
components.summary: Underlined primary words that act, with a 48 target around them.

components.name: Field
components.summary: The frame of every form control: its label, optional marker, hint and error around the control.

components.name: TextField
components.summary: A single-line text field: empty with a hint, filled with an icon, with an error and disabled.

components.name: TextArea
components.summary: A multi-line field for order notes, with its counter and its error.

components.name: SearchField
components.summary: The customer's search pill: empty, filled with its clear button, and loading.

components.name: PhoneField
components.summary: The sign-in phone number with its country chip, Syria or Turkey, read left to right inside the right-to-left form.

components.name: CountrySheet
components.summary: The phone field's country list: a search by name or calling code, Syria and Turkey first, then the last used.

components.name: CodeField
components.summary: The six cells of the sign-in code: typing, wrong code and accepted.

components.name: CodePreview
components.summary: What the WhatsApp message with the code will look like, the code masked; full and compact.

components.name: Select
components.summary: A single choice from a list, its menu open under the field with the choice ticked, and empty with an error.

components.name: DateField
components.summary: A date chosen from the calendar picker, shown with Western digits, and empty with an error.

components.name: TimeField
components.summary: A time of day chosen from the picker, shown with «ص» and «م», and disabled.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: A checkbox with its label: unchecked, checked, mixed, invalid and disabled.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.summary: Radio buttons in a named group with one tab stop: a choice made, an error and a disabled option.
components.platform: Flutter also exports `FoxRadio`, the single option the country sheet lists as its rows

components.name: Switch
components.summary: An on and off setting such as order notifications, enabled and disabled.

components.name: QuantityStepper
components.summary: The quantity of a cart line: minus becomes delete at the minimum, plus stops at the maximum.

components.name: Money
components.summary: An amount in Western tabular digits with its currency, in its sizes, signs and tones, for the phone and the captain.

components.name: StatusChip
components.summary: The nine order states as tinted chips with an icon and words, compact for dense lists, and a free tone.

components.name: CountBadge
components.summary: A dot or a count on an icon's corner, 99+ when large, orange for the cart and inline in a tab.

components.name: Card
components.summary: The card shell: an outline, the customer app's offset shadow, a pressable card and a late one.

components.name: ListRow
components.summary: A row of a list or settings page: pressable with its chevron, with a value or a chip, danger and disabled.

components.name: Timer
components.summary: An order's countdown, calm, soon and in minutes, and the late time counting up, for the restaurant and the captain.

components.name: CountdownRing
components.summary: The ring around the captain's new offer, emptying over its 45 seconds.

components.name: OrderCard
components.summary: The restaurant board's order card with its timer and one main action, new and late.

components.name: OrderRow
components.summary: A row of the customer's «طلباتي» list: the restaurant, the date, the state and the total.

components.name: Logo
components.summary: A restaurant's logo, or its initials when it has none, in a circle.

components.name: AmountsSummary
components.summary: The money lines of an order and its total: the customer cart's orange total bar, and plain elsewhere.

components.name: RestaurantCard
components.summary: The customer's restaurant card with its rating, time and fee, a favourite, and closed with its reopening time.

components.name: DishCard
components.summary: A menu dish row with its square photo and «+»: in the cart, unavailable and plain.

components.name: TrackingSteps
components.summary: An order's way in four steps: done in blue, the current one orange with a soft pulse, the rest dashed.

components.name: DropLoader
components.summary: The project's one loader: the mark fills with a swaying liquid, then fades back; 16, 24 and 48, and inside a busy button.

components.name: Skeleton
components.summary: The calm loading blocks in the shape of the content that comes, still under reduced motion.
components.platform: the web lays out `Skeleton.Block` elements; Flutter lays out `FoxSkeletonBlock` widgets

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: An empty list and an error in the logo's drop, with one action.

components.name: DataTable
components.summary: The panel's table, compact 40, with sort, selection, loading and empty rows.

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: A question that blocks the screen, its safe action first in focus, in the phone and captain themes.
components.platform: Flutter opens it with `showFoxDialog`, which can place it at the bottom, in the captain’s thumb zone

components.name: ConfirmDialog
components.summary: The confirmation of a destructive or financial action: a required reason, the money effect and who is notified.

components.name: Drawer
components.summary: A full-height panel over the page: the quick view from a table at the end side, the sidebar on a phone at the start side.

components.name: BottomSheet
components.summary: A sheet from the bottom: the customer's item sheet with the S-curve tab, and the restaurant's plain status sheet.

components.name: Toaster
components.summary: The dark blue toast in its four tones, with an action, shown one at a time above the bottom bar.
components.platform: the web wraps the app in `Toaster` and shows a toast with `useToast().show()`; Flutter wraps it in `FoxToaster` and shows `FoxToast` with `FoxToaster.of(context).show()`

components.name: Banner
components.summary: The banners under the top bar: red solid, then yellow, amber, blue and grey tinted, each with an icon and words.

components.name: BannerStack
components.summary: The banners in their priority order: two shown and the rest behind a counter that opens them.

components.name: BlockingBanner
components.summary: The panel's blocking sound banner (AP §7.3): it covers the page after sign-in until alert sound is enabled.

components.name: VersionTicket
components.summary: The forced update's head: a ticket with the installed version struck and the required one below.

components.name: ShopSign
components.summary: The maintenance head: an orange board hung from a nail, with the return time when the panel gives one.

components.name: Menu
components.summary: A list of actions under its trigger, a destructive one after a separator.
components.platform: on Android, back closes an open `FoxMenu` before the page

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: A short description on hover (after 500 ms) and on keyboard focus (at once).

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Underline tabs with counts for boards and detail pages, and the customer's pill tabs.

components.name: TopBar
components.summary: The phone apps' bar: the round back button, the orange title and an optional end action.

components.name: RestaurantBar
components.summary: The restaurant app's bar: its name, the status pill, the connection dot with its word and the support button.

components.name: BottomNavigation
components.summary: The Figma file's floating bar, icons only, in the customer, restaurant and captain apps.

components.name: Sidebar
components.summary: The navigation on the start side: the panel's collapsible sidebar and the restaurant's rail on tablets and Windows.
components.platform: the web Sidebar collapses and becomes a drawer below the tablet width; `FoxNavigationRail` is the restaurant tablet’s fixed rail, 88 wide with the names shown

components.name: PullToRefresh
components.summary: Pull to refresh with the mark filling as you pull, then the drop loader while it loads.

components.name: SignInHero
components.summary: The sign-in screen's head by where the guest came from: the saved cart, the way an order is followed, or what an account keeps.
